lines.text: AWS Lambda just doubled how long one run can last.
Lambda runs your code without you managing any servers. Each run has a time limit.
lines.title: What is Lambda?

lines.text: The limit was 15 minutes since 2018. Now it is 30, with a simple setting change.
lines.title: The new limit

lines.text: AWS says AI agent requests, video conversion, simulations and big reports were outgrowing 15 minutes.
lines.title: Who needs it

lines.text: Longer runs need more capacity. One request a second at 30 minutes each needs 1,800 runs at once.
lines.title: Capacity check

lines.text: Check what surrounds the function too, like queue wait times, retries and cost.
lines.title: Check around it

lines.text: The takeaway: more time is useful, but it is not a fix for slow code.
lines.title: Takeaways
